title: We sat down with the devs and superstars at WWE2K26 Creator Fest to breakdown WWE2K26 👊

author: Xbox
description:
On this episode of the Official Xbox Podcast, we're at a dream location for Malik: WWE Headquarters in Stamford, Connecticut. We're talking to the WWE Superstars and devs behind WWE 2K26 about match types, changes to Universe, presentaiton, and so much more.

00:00 Introduction
01:05 CM Punk interview
04:38 Which Superstar should you pick in WWE 2K26?
08:04 Interview with Lynell Jinks and Bryan Williams
09:28 MyFaction and New Reversal System
11:25 New Match Types
12:44 What's new in the game as far as presentation goes?
17:00 Showcase Mode
19:13 Gaunlet format in Showcase
20:52 Universe Mode
22:25 Rival Reactions
23:47 What are you most excited for players to experience in WWE 2K26?
27:39 Outro
